title: Reactivity of carboxylic acid derivatives
caption: Towards nucleophiles: acyl chlorides > acid anhydrides > esters > amides. The better the leaving group (Cl⁻ best, NH₂⁻ worst) and the less the lone pair next to C=O feeds into it, the more reactive the derivative.
alt: Ethanoyl chloride, ethanoic anhydride, methyl ethanoate and ethanamide in order of decreasing reactivity.
